name: Custom Shape Rotating Wood Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: Crafted from high-quality wood, which is sturdy and lightweight.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

- Available in three size options, this sign suits everything from desktop to wall display:
8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
12 x 12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
- Can be customized shape so the product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Construction – Multi-Layer Design with Rotation Option:

- Layer Options: 3-Layered Design or 4-Layered Design (3mm per layer): Each layer adds dimension and sturdiness, giving the piece a striking 3D appearance.
 - The total thickness for 3 Layered Sign is 1cm ~ 0.39in and 4 Layered Sign is 1.3cm ~ 0.52in.
- Rotating Axis (4mm axis core): A functional rotating mechanism allows the central layer to spin, making the sign interactive and more visually engaging. This special feature is ideal for dynamic décor or playful gift presentation.

 

  • Easy to Use: Slider mechanism allows smooth rotation for dynamic and interactive displays.

 

  • Printing Technology: Utilizes advanced UV printing technology for vibrant, high-resolution images that are crisp, detailed, and fade-resistant.

 

  • Functional Use:

This wooden sign is both decorative and functional, offering two modes of setup:
- Hanging Display: Includes strong rope and metal hooks for easy wall mounting.
- Tabletop Display: Comes with custom-fit wooden stands, perfect for desks, shelves, or mantels.

 

  • Perfect Gift Ideal: 

- Great for decorating living rooms, bedrooms, offices, or sports-themed rooms. Its rotating feature adds a unique interactive element, especially appealing for kids and sports fans.

- Ideal Gift for Any Occasion: A heartfelt and versatile gift for Fathers, Family Members, Friends, and Sports Fans. Perfect for Father’s Day, Birthdays, Christmas, Anniversaries, or just to show appreciation and love.
 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wood Sign , 1x Wooden Stand, 1 x Long jute twine

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
